accepted_recoveries: Change the hostname anti-affinity rule from required to preferred for this workload.
Use a satisfiable topology domain that preserves intended spreading when such topology is present and evidenced.
forbidden_actions: Do not delete healthy replicas to hide the unavailable replica.
Do not reduce desired replicas below the benchmark requirement.
Do not alter scheduler policy cluster-wide.
incident.injected_fault: A three-replica recommendations Deployment requires hostname-level pod anti-affinity in a two-node worker pool, leaving the final replica permanently unschedulable.
observable_signals: FailedScheduling events report that required pod anti-affinity rules cannot be satisfied.
Available nodes have adequate CPU and memory but already host matching replicas.
preconditions: Exactly two worker nodes are eligible for recommendations pods.
The Deployment requires three ready replicas for the test SLO.
Both eligible nodes have capacity for an additional replica.
required_evidence: Capture desired, ready, and unavailable replica counts.
Capture the required podAntiAffinity rule and topology key.
Capture matching pod placement across eligible nodes.
Demonstrate that resource pressure and taints are not the scheduling cause.

payload.answer: The incident is caused by a scheduling deadlock on the recommendations-api deployment in namespace proofix-case-05. The deployment spec configures a strict podAntiAffinity rule (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname for pods matching label app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api. With only one available worker node (vm-2) hosting a matching replica, the scheduler fails to place the remaining replica, resulting in FailedScheduling events and leaving the replica permanently Pending. The node has adequate CPU and memory without pressure conditions or taints blocking scheduling. The recovery is to change the pod anti-affinity rule from requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution to preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname so replicas can be co-located when node capacity allows.

critical_claims.claim: The recommendations-api deployment requires 2 replicas, with 1 ready/available replica and 1 unavailable replica.

The recommendations-api deployment template and pods enforce requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution pod anti-affinity on topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname for app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api.
Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-c5q8z is running on node vm-2 while pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-xq6g9 remains Pending due to pod anti-affinity rules on the available node.
Node vm-2 is Ready with False MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, and PIDPressure, confirming that resource constraints and taints are not the cause of the unschedulable replica.
